layers.stated: Virtue burns the loveless as the sun burns a boneless creature.

note: Plain admonition; the worm image is meant to make the loveless squirm but no one of the eight is shown.

layers.stated: Why use harsh words when one sees the pleasure sweet words give?

note: Rhetorical question as admonition; flat instruction.

layers.stated: Straight speech is rectitude only if the mind within is also without bend.

note: கோட்டம் (bend) used of speech and mind is a dead metaphor; not tagged as a comparison.

layers.stated: However great one is, what use if one enters another's home without a millet's worth of thought?
Those who deserve good in this sea-girt world are those who do not touch another's wife.

note: Praise of a type of person, hence vaakai; நாமநீர் வைப்பு is an epithet for the world, not a setting.

layers.stated: Do not seek gain got by coveting; its fruit at ripening brings no glory.
He who tells others' faults will have his own picked out and told.
Spreading talk of useless things itself shows the speaker lacks goodness.
If one never harbours anger in the heart, all one wishes comes at once.

note: Anger is named but not made visible; no meyppadu.

layers.stated: If a ruler enjoys what he loves without its being known, his enemies' plans fail.

note: Counsel to the king (porul paal); no thinai of war applies directly.

layers.stated: Even the weak conquer if they pick the place and guard themselves while attacking.

note: Battle counsel; thumbai by subject, though it is strategy rather than a battle scene.

layers.stated: Saying is easy for anyone; doing as one said is hard.
A fort earns its excellence by the deeds that fell the enemy at the front.

note: Fort verse; uzhinai by porul 2.8, but it praises the fort rather than narrating a siege.

layers.stated: The world loves those who do not forsake long, unbroken friendships.

note: Praise of a type of person.

layers.stated: Those of bitter mind who cling to enmity cannot see the truth that triumphs.
Inner enmity, though as small as a split sesame seed, holds ruin.
The good woman Earth laughs at those who sit idle pleading poverty.

note: Land personified as a woman who mocks; நிலம் here is soil, not a landscape setting.

layers.stated: When I look, she softens and smiles gently; there is a grace in the swaying one then.

note: Hero's speech in the pre-union stage of reading her signs; kurinji by uri, no landscape.

layers.stated: I will not blink, knowing he would hide; for that the town calls him unloving.

kurippu.sense: the town's gossip (அலர்) is turned: his apparent absence is only that he lives in her eyes

note: Heroine's speech; the eye as his dwelling is implied, not stated.

layers.stated: Even the esteemed lack worth if not loved by the one they love.

note: தனிப்படர் மிகுதி: lament at unreturned love; neythal by uri, no landscape.

layers.stated: The drum beats once, again, and at the third the corpse is covered and fire taken; the dying carry the dead.

iraicchi.sense: the funeral drum sounds for the bearers too, who are themselves next

note: Funeral scene: kaanchi native. நன்றேகாண் is bitter irony.

layers.stated: Once the dancer in the skin bag has gone, it matters not how the body is dragged, buried, cast or reviled.

comparisons.tenor: the life that acts in the body

layers.stated: Those who do no penance now, lacking it before, stand at others' doors looking up and grieving.

note: Image of the beggar at the gate built to move pity and fear of the same fate.

layers.stated: Base heart that says let us prosper and forget virtue: your days are gone, say what you will do.

note: Address to one's own heart.

layers.stated: The great do not flare at insults from inferiors; the base brood, rant to the town and butt a pillar.

note: The base man's anger is made visible as comedy.

layers.stated: Those of sky-high families keep doing good even to those who harm them.

note: Praise of the well-born.

layers.stated: Those who know, restrain themselves, fear what is to be feared and live content rarely suffer.
Whoever gains the middle of the three gains the ends too; whoever fails suffers as if boiled in a pot.

kurippu.sense: the middle of அறம் பொருள் இன்பம், i.e. wealth, left unnamed

comparisons.tenor: the suffering of the one without wealth

layers.stated: A good cow's calf fetches a price and the rich man's words carry; the poor man's words glance off like a plough in dry soil.

comparisons.tenor: the unlearned rich man's words carrying weight

layers.stated: The well-born do good even when they cannot; the small do not even when they can; a saddled antelope cannot fight like a charger.
Friendship of the small lasts a few days; the bond with the steadfast holds like the path of the great.
True friendship stays open like a tree flower; none befriend those who open and close like pond flowers.
What use are friends close as a dog's small toe who give not a fly's foot of help? Seek those who are like the channel that makes fields yield.
One who stays home but cannot feed the hungry had better go be a guest elsewhere.
Lord of the cool hill land: bees leave the spent branch; those who have lost their prosperity have no kin.

iraicchi.sense: the addressee's ever-flowing streams set off the dried branch: his prosperity, unlike the fallen man's, still draws kin

note: Akam apparatus (address to the hill lord) on a puram counsel subject.

layers.stated: Those who do not give are poor though rich; those who will not beg even in poverty are great Muttaraiyar.

kurippu.sense: the name of a ruling line, and lords of the three lands: dignity as sovereignty

layers.stated: Shame is not failing to give or shrinking in fear, but staying silent about what the great did to one when reduced.

note: Definitional; text sense of the last line is doubtful.

layers.stated: The tiger will starve rather than eat prey fallen on its left; the excellent will not take heaven if it dulls their honour.

comparisons.tenor: the excellent refusing gain at the cost of honour

layers.stated: The ill-disposed do not take in virtue though they listen, as the tanner's dog chewing leather cannot relish milk-rice.

comparisons.vehicle: தோல் தின்னும் குணுங்கர் நாய் பாற்சோறு கொள்ளாமை
comparisons.tenor: the ill-disposed not taking in virtue

layers.stated: What matter whether they live or die, the shameless dull ones who see life go in a blink and do no good at all?

comparisons.tenor: the time life takes to leave

layers.stated: When the king guards the world well the worthy follow; when others come to seize it he is like a pouncing tiger.

note: The marked reading makes the tiger the usurper; the Tamil reads as well or better with the king as the tiger when others come to seize the land.

layers.stated: Austerity and virtue, made fruitful by the Lord, are a boat across the sea of deeds and support for oneself and kin.
Space and the elements, Sadasiva and the others, came forth within Shakti as Isa, Hara, Mal and Brahma for the world's care.

note: Cosmology; no thinai.

layers.stated: Fire takes earth, the eight mountains, the seven seas and space; the heart that knows this feels no wonder.

note: Dissolution of the world as நில்லா உலகம், by extension. Wonder (மருட்கை) is explicitly denied, so not tagged.

layers.stated: If the breath is even in both partners the child is fair; if it falters in both, she does not conceive.

note: Breath rule for conception; the bangled woman is not an akam situation.

layers.stated: With all their kinds of knowing, people perish without noticing their time being cut away.

note: Impermanence; the tattva-style counts of knowing are background.

layers.stated: Signs read from the hand on the head foretell six months or one month of life.

note: Signs of death: technical, refused a thinai per brief.

layers.stated: With no earth, water, stalk or root a lotus blooms; with no town there is a light; with no below or above, a flower in hearing.

kurippu.sense: the flower known through inner sound (nada), not sight

ullurai.tenor: the inner lotus of meditation where the light is seen

note: Setting explicitly denied; mystical vision that no thinai describes.

layers.stated: In the place without night or day, think of her of fragrant hair and join her soundlessly; the Supreme will rule you.

note: Union apparatus for Shakti meditation; time explicitly negated.

layers.stated: He who says I am this is in me as life in flesh, pours like the great cloud, and I become the lord of space.

note: Ends in identity (நானிது அம்பர நாதனும் ஆமே) but the body-life relation stated is union.

layers.stated: Above the cosmic mountain the bliss tattva pervades as five bodies and thirty-six, eightfold in the egg.

note: Tattva count.

layers.stated: Three mansions seat the three; in them arise the thirty-six; seeing the light that rises within them ends the body's reckoning.

ullurai.tenor: the three bodies or states of the soul

layers.stated: Turiya is the soul's purification; beyond waking, the vision of the Supreme and peace lie in his pervading oneself.

note: Technical states of consciousness; உபசாந்தம் is calm that the eight cannot hold.

layers.stated: Those who will not join the guru's mark wander talking fine words; what gain beside those who know and dance?
It needs no filling, takes no name, joins nothing, and shows itself without cause.

note: Apophatic exposition of the Absolute; no thinai.

layers.stated: What comes and fails is grace; Nandi gave grace to save; master the nine sense-paths and one can mount the horse of truth.

kurippu.sense: மெய் as body and truth: the body ridden as a horse once the senses are mastered

layers.stated: Nandi who joined hands with me, who mingled in my body, first of the Veda, pure one, is refuge only for those who leave falsehood.

kurippu.sense: mingled in my body and in truth

layers.stated: Wearing away the embryo, bonds, fear and births and righting the mind, the skilled who meet the test reach the Supreme.

note: Doctrinal exposition of release.

layers.stated: She of tender eyes who saw the Dancer, the inner light, looked on and sang the Vedas.

note: Mythic praise of Shakti beholding Siva; not akam despite the woman's gaze.

layers.stated: Putting the noose for the shed's jackal into the fire, standing long and entering good, he lived sweetly at home with the jewelled woman.

ullurai.tenor: the wayward mind in the body, its bonds burned in yogic fire, and union with Shakti/grace

comparisons.tenor: the restless mind in the body

note: Whole-image cipher; domestic life with the woman after long waiting gives mullai by uri.

layers.stated: If you leave me in birth, let me be whole, well-born and wise and take me into service; praise of the vel and Palani.
When will my life tossing in the sea of bought pleasure plunge into the sea of silent Siva-bliss? Praise of Arunai.
Drawn to women like needle to magnet, will I, the dog-servant, one day wear your lotus feet? Praise of Siva's dance and Puliyur.
This body of flesh, blood and bile, food for ghoul, dog and fly: take me from this pot to that and grant release.

kurippu.sense: இக்கடம், this pot and body and trouble, against அக்கடம், the state of release

layers.stated: Let me not wander in the lewd trade of deceitful women; will you look on me with grace? Praise of the wooer of the hunter girl at Tiruchengodu.
Free me from delusion for dancing women with Meru-like breasts; grant the meaning told to Siva. Praise of Thenseri hill.
A string of prayers: a mind beyond the senses and beyond night and day, Tamil to praise you, release, splendour, the meaning.

kurippu.sense: the lunar space of yoga in the head

layers.stated: Wounded by Madana's bow and burned by the moon, weeping all night, this girl wastes away; come and give her life. Praise of Murugan.

note: Spoken by a friend or mother for the girl (porul 2.23); thinai by uri though the hour is kurinji's யாமம்.

layers.stated: Kama's arrows and the flute torment this deer-like girl; come, look, join her, or give your kadamba garland.

note: Evening flute is mullai karu; asking for the garland as token marks waiting.

layers.stated: Through births in the womb-pit of deeds, fearing the rope, worms, burning and hell while kin weep, give me your feet of grace.

note: Kaanchi content inside a paadaan song.

layers.stated: I, rubbish-minded sinner who chased spear-eyed women, ask you to scold me like a mother and teach me one word.
Spun by fragrant women till called vile, will there be a day when the diseased body is shed and you sit in my breast?
I lack the devotees' conduct and virtue; let me not stumble on women's breasts and hair; I will not forget your feet. Praise of Krishna's nephew at Neruvai.
Hair white as cotton, deaf, blind, teeth loose, coughing, reviled by wife: on the day of the soul's distress, give grace.

note: Old-age catalogue (kaanchi content, porul 2.19) and a battle praise (thumbai content) inside paadaan.

layers.stated: Ruined by women whose eyes kill like poison and spear, when Death's host drags me to hell will your feet not come?
I, a dog who plunged into union with moon-faced women, ask for love that praises your feet. Praise of the hunter girl's lord.
Before kin grieve, the body burns in the long forest and Death's rope binds the life, give me the mind to praise your feet.

note: Kaanchi content (the funeral pyre) inside paadaan.

layers.stated: Rid of the madness women give, will I strive to worship you? Long praise of Siva.
Even in days lost in passion until two seem one, grant me ways to praise your feet, vel, face and grace. Battle praise.

note: Union is pictured with relish and kept within the prayer, so akam apparatus serves devotion.

layers.stated: With deeds, grey hair and suffering gone, let me bathe in Sivaganga, let Sivam enter me so my form is yours, and give the meaning.
Since you stay in me and never leave, when will I become one-pointed and never leave you?

note: Longing addressed to the god within; the eight have no slot.

layers.stated: Think of Siva, mind: all born die, the body is a stinking hut of openings ending as burnt bone; melt and think of the dancer of Tillai.

note: Long impermanence catalogue addressed to the mind ending in praise of Siva; kaanchi by its bulk.

layers.stated: Wandering day and night for prey around the pit of women's waists, I am alone; rule me, Kalathi under the banyan.
Shall I not see the cause of the darkened throat, and him among the devotees?

kurippu.sense: the poison swallowed to save the world, left unsaid

layers.stated: As my influence grew, a new delusion came; I stumbled head downward and was ruined.

note: Self-lament for the past; the puram frame has no slot for confession, paadaan by its address to god in the cycle.

layers.stated: Not seeing Rudra in the heart truly, I lost my purpose and was shaken, O Purnam.

note: Confession addressed to the Full; the feeling is helplessness, not one of the eight.

layers.stated: Food given to those who conquered the senses reaches the Lord; giving to idle wanderers is vain.
To be her child, kindle the fire in the root channel, drink that water, and through the lady of fragrant hair reach the Lord's feet.

kurippu.sense: the nectar that the kindled kundalini releases

note: Yogic technique.

layers.stated: Fools, are not the tattvas the crimes? As water rises at an opened sluice, raise the root channel and fix it.

note: ஏறு மாறு is better read as ஏறும் ஆறு (the way water rises) than the marked bull.

layers.stated: You carry books and babble lies, not knowing birth and death; know that and the inner light becomes joy.
It must not be said; said, it is a fault; no, no, you have seen solitude.

kurippu.sense: the mind addressed as the demon within

layers.stated: All deeds that appear you have seen as void; they appear without appearing in pure space.

kurippu.sense: the mind addressed as the demon within

layers.stated: To sing the kummi on the Maiden Ambika, Nandi's golden feet are our protection.

note: Invocation (காப்பு).

layers.stated: We will make the eight nagas dance, show Indra's world here, bind the unbindable snake; spit your poison and dance.

kurippu.sense: the coiled power/breath that the siddha masters

layers.stated: Lightning, lamp, slender one, vine, Menaka, sugar: we spurned these names for women without saying them; dance, snake.

kurippu.sense: the coiled power the siddha addresses

layers.stated: Taking the thought from the root up the sushumna to the bindu, by the young mother's grace we joined bliss; dance, snake.

kurippu.sense: the coiled power raised through the channel

layers.stated: What does talk reveal? Talking on is only error; a flawless inquiry of knowledge is needed.

note: Line 3 (வாச்சுதலால் அம்பு பூணும்) is obscure.

layers.stated: Not reaching the Brahman that is self, counting gods and gurus, the miserly ox who never saw the rising hill sins and falls to hell.

kurippu.sense: the inner summit where the light rises in yoga

layers.stated: In the small house of self, fix the turned breath in Brahman; the arrow joins the sky, hunger ends, the coats slip off.

kurippu.sense: breath and horse: the breath that has turned its head

layers.stated: The garbed beggar talking mouth-knowledge is a husk and a whole ox; do not heed him, and do not call body and life two.
